description: §19.10.4 (S453/B1b, RULED) — a `transaction { }` block at the TOP LEVEL of a `${}` logic block, outside any function, is E-ERROR-001. §19.10.4 already said the block is "valid only inside `!` functions"; S450 enforced that for a non-`!` FUNCTION (see ../transaction-non-failable-fn-neg/) and deliberately left the top level alone, routing it. bryan ruled it rejected, on E-ERROR-001 rather than a new code — the condition is one condition ("outside a `!` function") and the reason is one reason: a `fail` inside the block has nowhere to go, so the commit-or-rollback promise has no failure path to keep. `notCodes` pins that this is the governed refusal and not the pre-S450 E-SCOPE-001 parse degradation, and that the block is not mistaken for a nested one.
rationale: §19.10.4: "`transaction { }` SHALL be valid only inside `!` functions. A `transaction` block outside a `!` function — in a function not declared `!`, or at a top-level logic block — SHALL be a compile error (E-ERROR-001 applies)." Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S449 (B1b) — "a top-level `transaction` is rejected (§19.10.4 already says `!` functions only)".
